unresolved_gaps: No cited measurement estimates the representative share of real workloads reliably automatable in May 2025.
Limited whole-job replacement does not establish limited task automation.
Earlier realized time savings cannot place an upper bound on later technical capability.
The claim supplies no threshold distinguishing small from substantial automation.
